changes.note: The official KudiCubs logo (the cub holding the K coin, with "Play. Earn. Roar!") replaces the placeholder wordmark.
Kudi is now your official mascot (the wave pose). The placeholder cub drawing is gone.
The robot voice is removed. Kudi's line will be a real recorded voice; until then it shows "Recording pending".
Tap Kudi to hear "Hello, friend!", or tap the logo to hear "Play. Earn. Roar!".
Yellow and white cards with Mane Brown outlines, in the brand colours.
Each age card speaks when tapped; Kudi gives a thumbs up, or a gentle fist for "coming soon".
Each friend introduces themselves when tapped ("Hi! I'm Hopper the hare!"); each name chip says the name.
The selected card is highlighted in Soft Gold, the brand's character highlight.
The grown-up screens are now Mane Brown with the official logo on brown (previously indigo).
The hold button and keypads use Sunshine Yellow and Warm Cream on Mane Brown.
A white header with the logo; the yellow Continue button with a Mane Brown outline; Golden Orange coins with brown rims.
Tap your coins, a badge, your level or the market-day sun to hear it.
A replay button (↻, top right) on every screen repeats what Kudi last said.
Call and response: Kudi asks "Can you help me find them?" and the child taps 👍 before Start appears.
Tap the market stall to hear "The market!".
Every coin says its name when found ("Fifty pesewas!"), with a pop sound and Kudi's thumbs up.
The scene and coins use the brand palette; coins have Mane Brown rims.
Coins are dragged by hand into the jars. Each jar has a count badge that goes up by one with every coin.
Right jar: a chime and thumbs up. Wrong jar: the coin floats back, Kudi's fist ("Let's try a different jar!") and a soft boop. Never a failure.
Each tapped coin says its number ("One! Two! Three!").
Call and response: "Which jar has the most coins?" The child taps a jar. A wrong guess gets a kind "Let's look again".
Each choice card speaks when tapped ("Save them for later!" / "Spend them on a kelewele sticker!").
The treat changes by country: kelewele (Ghana), puff-puff (Nigeria), biscuit (UK).
The child taps the jar to drop in the last coin, with a sparkle and Kudi celebrating.
The positive message uses the proposed success green (pending your approval).
The child taps the sticker to stick it on. Spending is still a happy choice.
Call and response: "What did you do with your coins?" The child taps the save or spend picture.
Each recap tile says what the child did when tapped.
Tap the reward burst to pop the celebration again ("Woo-hoo!"); tap a badge to hear its name.
Kudi's celebrate pose, the brand-yellow Level Up banner, and Golden Orange coins.
Kudi names the money for each country ("These are Ghana cedis and pesewas.").
Tap any bar or history line to hear it.
Tap a level, badge or pillar to hear its name.
The market-road level path in brand colours; the current level is Sunshine Yellow.

openDecisions.title: B1 Yellow logo tagline
openDecisions.question: The yellow logo version has a white tagline, which is hard to read. Is there a version with a Mane Brown tagline, or shall we keep using the white and brown logo versions?

openDecisions.title: B2 Peace-sign pose
openDecisions.question: You asked for a "peace sign" pose for celebrating, but none of the five poses shows one. Can we use the wink pose with the sparkling coin, or will you send a peace-sign pose?

openDecisions.title: B3 Success green
openDecisions.question: The guide asks for a separate green for success messages. We propose #16793A. OK?

openDecisions.title: B4 Warm Cream
openDecisions.question: The guide prints the Warm Cream code as #F68C1F (that's the orange). We used the swatch colour, #FEF5E0. Correct?

openDecisions.title: B5 Charcoal
openDecisions.question: The guide says #000000, but the swatch looks like #231F20. Which one? (It isn't used in the app yet.)

openDecisions.title: B6 Button pressed shades
openDecisions.question: We made slightly darker versions of yellow and orange for pressed buttons, and a lighter brown for small text. Are you happy with them? (See brand.md.)

openDecisions.title: B7 Product name in text
openDecisions.question: Should app text say "KudiCubs", "Kudicubs" or "Kudicub's" (as in the logo)?

openDecisions.title: B8 Master files
openDecisions.question: Please send the original logo (vector) and the five mascot images (transparent PNG) for the final app.

openDecisions.title: B9 App fonts
openDecisions.question: We propose Baloo 2 and Nunito (free, licensed for apps) for buttons and text, to match the rounded logo. OK?

openDecisions.title: B10 Placeholder art colours
openDecisions.question: Our draft coins and scenes use a few extra colours (silver, bronze, flag colours on coins, greens). OK until final illustrations?

openDecisions.title: B11 App icon
openDecisions.question: For the phone home-screen icon we used just the cub and K coin from your yellow logo (the full logo is too small to read at icon size). Nothing is redrawn. OK, or would you prefer the full logo?

openDecisions.title: V1 First voice
openDecisions.question: Shall we record Ghanaian English first, with a warm female storyteller voice?
